attivita.h1: NAICS code for a hotel or motel
attivita.descrizione: Hotels and motels are NAICS 721110, casino hotels 721120, bed and breakfast inns 721191; hotel management and booking services too.
attivita.intro: Hotels and motels are 721110 «{t_721110}» unless they have a casino. The official index lists {n_voci} matching entries in {n_codici} codes, including bed and breakfast inns, other short-term lodging and hotel management or reservation services.

721110: Hotel management services (i.e., providing management and operating staff to run hotel)
561110: Hotel management services (except complete operation of client's business)
